label: Figure 14.2: The aggregate demand curve
alt: A downward-sloping AD curve labelled AD = C + I + G + (X - M). At price level PL1 real output demanded is Y1; at the lower PL2 it is the higher Y2.
caption: The AD curve, AD = C + I + G + (X−M). A fall in the average price level from PL1 to PL2 (purple arrow on the vertical axis) is a movement down along the curve, raising the real output demanded from Y1 to Y2 (purple arrow on the horizontal axis).
